title: CSP allows 'unsafe-eval'
recommendation: Avoid eval-based libraries; remove unsafe-eval directive.

title: CSP allows 'unsafe-inline'
detail: Inline scripts/styles allowed — defeats most XSS protection.
recommendation: Move inline scripts to external files, use nonces/hashes.

title: HSTS max-age too short
recommendation: Set max-age=31536000 (1 year) once you're confident.
